integrity: Analytic proof supplies exact all-depth formulas and equality rotations; standalone numerical verification tests finite instances only.
scientific_limitations: A fixed unitary is reused through a prescribed depth; the optimizing unitary may depend on depth and noise strength. Qubits, symmetric transverse dephasing, and \(0<q<1\) only. No higher-dimensional or arbitrary-filter extension. Literature priority is a best-knowledge assessment; independent verification has not been performed.
title: Sharp entanglement-breaking thresholds for repeated rotated qubit dephasing
